domain: Plain source objects and table numeric/string fields mapped to typed records
Valid stable arena handles; timers and source indices remain binary64
Null and undefined remain distinct for optional numeric and object-reference state
All nontranslated game mechanics are required hooks, with errors propagated
Callbacks queue and execute later; drain captures original queue identity; actor absence and playSound conditions follow original source branches
World.mode corresponds to ed.battleEngine.getMode(), which returns engine.mode in supplied source
Update hooks may mutate current phase, indices, casting, caster, info and callback queue; source reads are repeated at original call boundaries

differential.reference: original ed.Skill.update plus original queued callback bodies
differential.scope: timeline/control and fixture host mutations; not full battle equivalence
